facts.F5: The demand was repeated by another letter dated 9 December 1998, and then by an undated note in English addressed to Mr Nakamura of the Defendant setting out the amount due and also a breakdown list and the related invoices.
facts.F6: The Defendant suggested that it would have to take legal action against Beijing Junefield to obtain payment.
facts.F7: There was never any real dispute by the Defendant on the amount due and owing to the Plaintiff.
